Deterministic published selection and full-source license, revision, source timestamp, title and namespace audit, without development-query selection
General bounded HTML/math/table transformation preserving original source bytes, exact quote spans and reconstruction; reject unsupported transforms with counted reason
Durable per-original dispositions and duplicate/exclusion counts; distinct page/revision identities bound to originals
Actual Android retrieval, source inspection, citations, absent controls, corruption rejection, restart and retention on the current candidate

Independent source/rights and product evidence review; physical/no-GMS and unseen matched superiority stay separate unproven gates

Measure full-scale document/passage/FTS duplication, per-original transformation ledger and Android reader/import bounds; material architecture changes must keep byte-bound exact citations and the installed/update budget rather than dropping breadth
